text: November first. Washington State Patrol reports a driver on I-5 firing shots at troopers.
Thurston County deputies join the chase.
A deputy spikes the car. It loses control and hits the barrier.
Deputies chase him on foot, across the interstate.
He climbs a barbed wire fence and falls on the other side. A deputy tases him through the fence.
Then he rolls over, and shows a gun.
The deputy fires three shots while backing away.
He is not hit. He spits at deputies, gets tased again, and keeps running.
He runs toward a busy gas station. A man yells that he has a gun.
He had five prior felony convictions.
